name: EIA Open Data API
tagline: US Energy Information Administration open data API for energy statistics
description: Official US Energy Information Administration (EIA) REST API providing free access to energy production, consumption, prices, electricity, petroleum, natural gas, and related statistical series for the United States.

auth.details: API key via query parameter api_key=YOUR_API_KEY; free self-serve registration on EIA Open Data site

use_cases: fetch US electricity generation by fuel type
get petroleum price series over time
